title: 俄洛伊·海门长风
description: 绿发俄洛伊穿完整祭司衣甲，在高大海门前沉稳站立，巨大神像稳放身侧，海光与金属形面清楚分层。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Illaoi is a powerful broad-shouldered adult woman with dark brown skin, thick green hair, strong facial features, and a sea-priestess identity. Preserve her substantial natural physique and green-gold ceremonial ornaments in a fully covering patterned tunic, layered armor, opaque lower garments, and sturdy footwear. Her massive golden many-faced idol rests securely on a stone plinth beside her, not raised or swung.
art_direction.scene: She stands firmly beneath an immense coastal archway, one palm resting on the grounded idol and the other relaxed at her side. The horizon opens broadly behind her without crowds or spectral tentacles. Hard reflected sea light and a warm side beam turn cloth and gold into coarse wax-crayon facets, making the pose monumental, focused, and peaceful.
art_direction.palette: deep green, warm brown, sea blue, antique gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
